answer: New agents must first bind a hardware-attested enclave that mints a one-time onyx shard encoding a unique timing fingerprint; a circling raven of independent verifiers then samples the shard across staggered windows, assembling an iridescent opal of cross-checked continuity that collapses if any clone tries to reuse the same silicon. Sybils pay the full hardware cost per identity or watch their forged proofs shatter under the lattice.
